[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]One reference grammar names every artifact SASE knows: `plans:` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]generalizes into `<kind>:<payload>` references covering commits, [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]prompt bar (highlighted, completed, and expanded at launch), and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]external editors through LSP completion, diagnostics, and semantic [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]tokens.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Kind-tagged artifact reference grammar in the Rust core[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]ref-core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ref-core: add the `artifact_ref` module to the Rust core — parse, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]render, canonicalize, and resolve kind-tagged references with per-kind [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]payloads, fragment anchors, caller-supplied document roles, and a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prompt-text scanner — reusing the `plans:` machinery without changing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]any `plan/refs.rs` behavior, and expose it through new PyO3 bindings.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Python artifact-reference facade and context resolution[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ref-facade[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ref-facade: add the Python facade that builds per-project resolution [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]context (document roles and roots, chats root, artifact index, repos, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]projects), wraps the new bindings behind schema gates, renders canonical[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]references from ACE entry targets and rows, and bumps the sase-core-rs [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]floor.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Copy and hand off references from the Artifacts sub-tabs[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]copy-ref[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-facade[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]copy-ref: give Commits, Plans, Chats, and Bugs copy-mode targets that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]copy the selected entry's `@`-reference and seed a new agent prompt with[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]it (including marked sets), and show the logical reference beside its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolved path in the Plans and Chats detail surfaces.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Recognize and expand artifact references at launch[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]prompt-grammar[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-facade[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]prompt-grammar: recognize `@<kind>:<payload>` references in launched [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prompts through the core scanner and expand them per kind — documents, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]chats, and artifact files to real paths, commits and bugs to their [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]locators — before file-reference processing, failing the launch clearly [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]when a known-kind reference does not resolve.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Artifact-reference highlighting in the prompt input widget[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]prompt-highlight[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-facade[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]prompt-highlight: syntax-highlight artifact references in the prompt [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]editor with per-part styles (sigil, kind, separator, payload, fragment) [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]driven by the core scanner and a cached known-kind set, following the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]xprompt highlighter pattern, with PNG snapshot coverage.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Artifact-reference completion in the prompt bar[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]prompt-complete[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-facade, prompt-highlight[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]prompt-complete: complete artifact references in the prompt bar — kinds [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]after `@`, payloads per kind from warm cached providers for documents, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]artifact files, chats, commits, and bugs — through a pre-tokenizer [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]context detector, and record used references into file-reference [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]history.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Artifact-reference completion and diagnostics in the xprompt [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]LSP[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]lsp-complete[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-core, ref-facade[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]lsp-complete: complete and diagnose artifact references in the Rust [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]xprompt LSP server, fed by a launcher-materialized artifact catalog, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]mirroring the prompt bar's recognition and known-kind rules so editors [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the TUI agree on what a reference means.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Semantic-token highlighting for artifact references in editors[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]lsp-tokens[dim] · [dim][/dim]after lsp-complete[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]lsp-tokens: add a semantic-tokens provider to the xprompt LSP that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]colors artifact references in external editors using standard LSP token [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]types, so default editor themes highlight them with no client [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]configuration.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
